experiment: DEPTH C1: charged L1-continuation vs cold L, ordinary IID SPSA

hypothesis.one_sentence: If L>1 fade is mostly a cold start, then spending part of Q=qL on an L1 fit and continuing from that energy-selected point into the extra layers will beat a cold L fit on energy.
hypothesis.not: No free L1. No extra gain/scale. No orthogonal frames.

allocation.cold: Ordinary C0, 4 starts, cap Q=qL, TQA+U(-0.6,0.6). All calibration, perturb, candidates inside Q.
allocation.cont_L1: Ordinary C0 at L=1, 4 starts, cap 1024, charged to the same arm Q. Energy selects x*_L1.
allocation.cont_rest: Remaining Q-1024 at depth L. Start 0 is pad(x*_L1). Starts 1-3 perturb only the new-layer coordinates U(-0.6,0.6). Ordinary C0 on that remainder.
allocation.pad_Nov3: [γ,θK,θM,s_layer1, 0,0,0,...] extra shells zero. Shared γ is still applied on new layers.
allocation.pad_QAOA: gammas [γ0,0,...], betas [β0,0,...]. Extra layers are identity.

optimizer.kind: ordinary IID Rademacher SPSA, C0 simultaneous gain

selection: Lowest counted candidate energy. F post hoc. GS/F never select.

gate.cell: N15 L3 Nov3, n=8, energy E_cont - E_cold
gate.adopt_continuation: bootstrap 95% CI of the mean ΔE lies entirely below 0
gate.otherwise: reject continuation. Do not scan another split.

report: continuation vs cold within method: paired Δ(E-E0)/N and ΔF, mean, CI, n(ΔE<0), n(ΔF>0)
Nov3 vs QAOA using per-seed energy-better of cold/cont, same paired stats
